title: Netflix’s F1 series Drive to Survive will stream on Apple TV, too
summary: Netflix's sports docuseries obsession started a few years ago with F1: Drive to Survive, but when the eighth season premieres after midnight tonight, it will also be available on Apple TV. Now that Apple TV has a five-year deal to be the US streaming home for F1 races, subscribers in the US will be able to catch every episode of the new Drive to Survive sea…
